messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts detected for tenant 'MarigoldRetail' on dedicated cluster eu-west-2-3. Error rate: 17% 5xx over 5m, spike started 00:00:18 UTC. Impact: ~30% requests failing with 502/504. Link: https://console.redwood/alerts/3141592653
ryan: oncall here — acknowledge. paging SRE + infra. tagging marigold-cs for customer impact. /cc @olivia @miguel-infra @satya-eng
olivia: I'm in. pulling logs now. first glance: lots of kv-eviction and grpc stream resets from worker pods.
anna: CS pinged marigold support channel — heads up, they're seeing increased errors. asked for timestamps and example request ids.
miguel-infra: running quick cluster check — `kubectl -n dedicated-marigold get pods -o wide` shows 2 pods OOMKilled in the model-worker pool, other pods entering CrashLoopBackOff. GPU utilization on node n0-3 at 98%.
ryan: likely noisy neighbor or sudden load profile change. any autoscale activity?
miguel-infra: `kubectl describe hpa marigold` shows max replicas hit, autoscaler couldn't get more quota. cluster scheduler logs show pending pods due to insufficient GPU resources.
satya-eng: model serving logs show backpressure and large batch sizes suddenly — a tenant-side batch job might be spiking throughput. sample logs:
```
2026-03-15T00:00:12Z model-worker[pod-7]: kv_store eviction for tenant marigold: evicted 124820 keys in 2s
2026-03-15T00:00:15Z model-worker[pod-9]: kernel launch failed: out of memory
2026-03-15T00:00:16Z gateway: upstream reset: connection aborted by peer
```
ryan: quick mitigation options: 1) move Marigold to spare pool, 2) throttle top sources, 3) enable temporary per-tenant qps cap, 4) add capacity (hot scale). which is fastest?
olivia: fastest is route override to spare pool + per-tenant throttling. hot scale could take 5-10m pending quota.
ryan: miguel, execute route override and enable tenant throttle. include rollback steps.
miguel-infra: running: `redwood-admin route override --tenant marigold --from eu-west-2-3 --to spare-eu-standby --reason "mitigate noisy neighbor"`
miguel-infra: override applied. traffic draining from eu-west-2-3 -> spare-eu-standby.
anna: CS update sent: "We've routed your traffic to a standby pool to reduce errors; we're monitoring and will update in 10m." customer replied: "Thanks — we see steady decrease in errors on our side."
satya-eng: enabling per-tenant qps cap: `redwood-admin tenant update marigold --qps 15` — applied.
ryan: monitoring metrics... error rate dropping from 17% -> 4% in last 2m. latency stable. gateway timeouts reduced.
olivia: checking KV metrics: eviction rate down 90%. GPU pressure on eu-west-2-3 still high but isolated to noisy pods.
miguel-infra: isolated offending job — tenant marigold had a scheduled bulk-embed job hitting a new model variant with higher mem footprint. we throttled QPS and moved production traffic. will coordinate with billing/CS.
lee-cs: updated Marigold with timeline and cause summary. they requested incident number and whether any data lost — confirmed no data loss, just increased error responses.
ryan: good work. next steps: 1) keep routing override for 30m and monitor, 2) open capacity request to infra quota for hot-add to eu-west-2-3, 3) request Marigold to reschedule bulk job or use batch API, 4) follow-up postmortem and remediation to add per-tenant safety caps. I'll create a postmortem ticket.
anna: adding incident tag and severity P2 in tracker. assigning postmortem to @satya-eng and @miguel-infra.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation successful. error rate returned to baseline. hotfix: tenant qps cap + route override applied. Next update expected in 30m or when fully resolved.
ryan: moving to monitoring -> on-call handoff to evening team in 25m. if error rate creeps >5% re-escalate.
miguel-infra: FYI we captured heap dumps from the crashed pods and tenant job identifiers; saving artifacts in /artifacts/incidents/3141592653 for postmortem.
satya-eng: will audit model variant mem profiles and add an alert for sudden batch-size changes.
lee-cs: marigold confirmed reduced errors and appreciated quick response. closing loop after postmortem. :thumbsup:
ryan: thanks team. logging this thread and creating postmortem doc. archiving channel thread.
